messages.content: The airline moved our Friday Bangor flight from 12:40 to 11:20. They will also let us switch to a 4:05 p.m. flight from Portland without adding airfare. We are still ending with the final night in Bar Harbor. Which return is more workable?

The Portland return is more workable. An 11:20 Bangor departure would put you on the road from Bar Harbor around 7:30 a.m. once you allow for the drive, rental return, and airport processing. The 4:05 Portland flight requires a much longer drive, but leaving Bar Harbor around 10:00 a.m. should provide a reasonable buffer for the roughly three-hour drive, a fuel stop, and the rental return.
Would changing airports disturb either hotel reservation?
No. Keep the confirmed Portland-then-Bar Harbor hotel sequence exactly as it is, including the final night in Bar Harbor. Only the return flight and the rental-car return location need attention.
The car is already a one-way rental from Portland to Bangor. Is changing the drop-off to Portland likely to simplify it?

Operationally, yes: it becomes a Portland round-trip rental rather than a one-way rental. Before changing it, have the agency reprice the full reservation and confirm that the one-way fee disappears, the same vehicle class remains available, and the pickup time and terms do not change. A round-trip rate could still differ from the current $501 total.
Compare the two airport plans in one concise recommendation, and be clear about what has not been changed.

Choose the 4:05 p.m. Portland return. Bangor preserves the shorter drive but the new 11:20 departure creates an uncomfortably early start and little recovery time for traffic or rental delays. Portland adds roughly two hours of driving but gives you a substantially wider morning margin and keeps the final Bar Harbor night intact. First verify the live Portland flight details and that the airline exchange is truly fare-neutral; then obtain the revised Portland-return rental total and confirm the one-way fee is removed. If both checks hold, change only the return flight and rental drop-off. Leave both confirmed hotels unchanged. No flight, rental, or hotel change has been made here.
